profile.headline: Software Engineer at Arista Networks
profile.summary:
ECE graduate at the University of Waterloo (Class of 2014) with a decent amount of industry experience through various internships. Self taught in programming and always eager to learn.

Aiming for a engineering career in the heart of Silicon Valley.

positions.title: Hardware Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-PCB design
-FPGA/CPLD design in Verilog
-Board bring ups and various lab work (board reworks and bebug, control system validation, etc...)

positions.title: Platform Engineer
positions.description: Using Python and C to validate hardware design correctness

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- reformatted assembly code to run in win32/unix
- optimized functionality via GCC inline assembly
- bug fixing & develop/improved statistics window for in-house video player
- visual review of video

positions.title: Software Test Associate
positions.description:
-Develop and execute various types of tests such as regression, performance, capacity, GUI, integration and functional tests on production and prototype hardware.

-Automated generation of various reports

positions.title: Software Engineering
positions.description:
-Intern for Ericsson's Operation Support Systems R&D unit for broadband access products.

- Designed, implemented and tested software for this bulk provisioning application.
